body:
**RALEIGH, N.C. -** Eric Tulsky, General Manager of the National Hockey League’s Carolina Hurricanes, today announced that the team has signed goaltender **Pyotr Kochetkov** to a two-year contract extension. The deal will pay Kochetkov $2.4 million with a $1.5 million signing bonus for the 2027-28 season and $3 million with a $1 million signing bonus for the 2028-29 season.

**“Pyotr is an incredibly talented goalie whose aggressive style fits our team very well,”** said Tulsky. **“We believe in his ability to win games for this organization and are thrilled he wants to continue helping us pursue championships in Carolina.”**

About Pyotr Kochetkov:

*   The 27-year-old, who missed the majority of the 2025-26 season with a lower-body injury, posted a 6-2-0 record with a 2.33 goals-against average and .899 save percentage in nine games with the Hurricanes.
*   He appeared in three games with the Chicago Wolves in 2025-26, going 1-0-0 with a 1.55 GAA and .940 SV%.
*   The Penza, Russia native went 27-16-3 with a 2.60 GAA and .898 SV% in 47 games with the Hurricanes in 2024-25 and added a 1-1-0 record with a 3.60 GAA and .855 SV% in four playoff games.
*   Carolina’s second-round selection, 36<sup>th</sup> overall, at the 2019 NHL Draft, Kochetkov has played 125 career NHL games with the Hurricanes and has a career record of 71-38-12 with a 2.46 GAA and .905 SV%.
*   The 6’3”, 196-pound netminder has posted a 34-7-4 record, 2.34 GAA, .912 SV% and three shutouts in 47 career AHL games with Chicago and Syracuse.
